correctness.rationale: For n≥3,a≥1,q≥3 and labelled core/leaves/palette, each core neighborhood is determined by equality or inequality of its two proper-colored cycle neighbors; inclusion–exclusion EGFs subtract exactly the assignments with no singleton, giving r_a(q),s_a(q). A proper core coloring has multiplicative independent leaf extensions. The ordered-distinct-color transition matrix T (dimension q(q−1)) has a constant eigenvector h; (q−1) standard two-dimensional blocks with characteristic equation λ²+sλ+(s−r)h; and zero-row/column symmetric and antisymmetric sectors of dimensions q(q−3)/2 and (q−1)(q−2)/2 with eigenvalues r−s,s−r. Dimension sum is exact, so the resulting trace formula holds for every n; U_j obeys the characteristic recurrence even with repeated roots. At q=3, r=a,s=2; at a=2 all core colorings have 2^n extensions. Independent brute core and transfer checks match selected q,a,n values including (3,2,5), (4,2,4). Finite cases alone cannot prove all parameters.
residual_risks: The finite checker cases are corroboration, whereas the matrix invariant decomposition supplies all-n proof.
